items.quote: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us
items.claim: The Israelites requested the speaker make gods for them to lead them

items.quote: this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt
items.claim: Moses is identified as the one who brought the Israelites out of Egypt

items.quote: we wot not what is become of him
items.claim: The Israelites do not know what has become of Moses
